title: OpenAI and four rivals just agreed on one standard for AI agents - The Next Web
excerpt: A Romanian republication of the original The Next Web article. Covers the Agent Plugins standard: OpenAI, Amazon, Microsoft, Cursor and Vercel agreed on a shared format bundling MCP servers and Agent Skills into one package with a plugin.json manifest. The standard is narrow by design, defining packaging and discovery but leaving marketplaces, permissions, sandboxing, and trust to each client. Reactions include support from developer advocate Angie Jones and skepticism from SST creator Dax Raad.
